prompt: Create a tmux session called checks, split its window into two panes, run pytest -q in one and show checks.log in the other, show me the results, then remove the session.

steps.caption: This server has no split tool, so split from inside the pane the create result returned (%1) with tmux itself.
List the panes of the session the create result returned ($1); each carries its position and size.
Run the tests in the pane the create result returned (%1) and wait for the summary.
Show the log in the new pane the list returned (%2) and wait for its last line.
Remove the session by the id the create result returned ($1).
